cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Put me down as café shift leader. We need tomorrow's stock order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who put you in charge? I usually do the order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And you're excellent at it. How much milk for tomorrow?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order it, but I'm writing 'appointment unconfirmed' beside your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave names off. Make it a supplies list; milk doesn't need a leadership column.

mechanism: A professionally redirects a challenge to shift-leader legitimacy into precise stock-order tasks, then removes the form field that would preserve the challenge.
confusable: D61 hides causing a problem; D62 specifically prevents discussion of where A authority comes from.
comparison: Costume alternative narrows inspection into assistance; cafe alternative removes leadership documentation to avoid examination.
seedUse: Cafe shift leader, milk order and appointment-unconfirmed note derive from D62-a; S03 adds stock-unit and form-scope corrections.
